title: Search an element in the LL
stepTitle: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
category: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
problemStatement: Solve “Search an element in the LL” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Learn 1D LinkedList).
intuition: "Search an element in the LL" needs careful pointer rewiring. Draw before/after. Prefer O(1) aux when possible; never lose the next reference before rewiring.

approaches.title: Hash / multi-pass when helpful
approaches.idea: Store nodes or lengths when it simplifies correctness, then optimize.

approaches.title: Optimal pointer technique
approaches.idea: Fast/slow, dummy head, or in-place reverse — adapt to the problem.

commonMistakes: Forgetting dummy head for head-deletion cases
patternRecognition: Intersection → length align or switch pointers
interviewInsight: For "Search an element in the LL", interviewers watch pointer hygiene more than clever tricks.
